name: Aryu Form Builder
author: Aryu Enterprises Private Limited

sections.description:
Form Builder lets you create forms with a visual builder, store entries, and display forms via shortcode.

Features:
* Drag-and-drop form builder (basic implementation)
* Field types: Text, Email, Textarea, Number, Phone, Checkbox, Radio, Select
* Shortcode embedding: [aryu_form_builder id=”X”]
* Entry storage with meta
* Admin entries list with filters, search, edit, delete, and CSV export
* Settings page (per-form field and global style settings)
* REST API endpoints
* Clean modular code structure

Note: Email notifications are currently disabled in this version.

Privacy

This plugin stores form submissions in custom database tables on your WordPress site. Submitted field values, and optionally the submitter IP address and user agent, are stored for form entry management. No data is sent to external services by this plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to ARYU Form Builder in the admin menu to create your first form.
sections.faq:
How do I display a form?

Use the shortcode [aryu_form_builder id="1"] (replace 1 with your form ID).

Where are entries stored?

In custom database tables: {prefix}aryufb_forms, {prefix}aryufb_entries, {prefix}aryufb_entry_meta.
sections.changelog:
1.5.1

  • Renamed custom database tables from the generic fbuilder_* names to aryufb_forms, aryufb_entries, aryufb_entry_meta (fully unique/prefixed table names).
  • Renamed the admin builder’s JS global from FB_Builder to ARYUFB_Builder to avoid namespace collisions with other plugins.
  • Verified all functions, classes, defines, options, hooks, capabilities, the shortcode, and the text domain use the unique aryufb/ARYUFB_/aryu-form-builder prefix (per WordPress.org plugin review feedback).

1.4.8

  • Version alignment for WordPress.org readiness.
  • Security: nonce protection on CSV export.
  • Security: whitelist ORDER BY columns in forms query.
  • Readme and shortcode documentation updates.
  • Added LICENSE file.

1.0.0

  • Initial release with core architecture.
